harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent name-based websites on node1 sharing TCP 8080. Both tenant trees serve correctly, unknown hosts return 404, staged content is unchanged, and service recovery was verified after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created a Python 2.5-compatible HTTP service for the legacy Ubuntu 7.10 platform.
Mapped docs.branch.test to the docs tree and orders.branch.test to the orders tree.
Configured strict unknown-host rejection and cross-tenant isolation.
Registered the service with SysV init and ran it as www-data.
Restarted node1 and verified automatic recovery without changing its OS release or kernel.

evidence.requirement: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP 8080 and serve their respective trees
evidence.summary: A single listener on port 8080 returned the documentation index/handbook and purchasing index/catalog according to Host.

evidence.requirement: Unknown hosts receive an error and tenant content remains isolated
evidence.summary: Unknown Host requests returned 404; attempts to access orders files through the docs host and docs files through the orders host also returned 404.
All five staged-file MD5 checksums remained identical before configuration, after configuration, and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are retained
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained in place.

Healthy baseline boot ID 9ddc07f0-0445-436b-a0aa-160722ced61f was captured, reboot was acknowledged, post-restart boot ID changed to 66147a27-445a-4fdf-9e46-0a279d5dfa0c, and the service, listener, routing, rejection behavior, and content all recovered.
